title: 第3章 当场被抓第4章 总管老太监
lines: 药膳房隶属尚膳监，名字虽然高端，其实就是个厨房。
与其他御厨不同，药膳房性质特殊，平常饭菜一概不做，只负责为皇帝处理丹食。
就是将各种炼制好的灵丹，辅以灵药做引，配以灵泉为剂，再借灵石真火充薪，做成餐桌上的美味。
丹药在修仙世界的地位举足轻重，它要是排第二，那就只有挂批敢说第一了。
所以话又说回来了，药膳房虽然只是厨房，也是皇宫最重要的厨房。
只因皇上也修仙。
不仅修，并且沉迷其中。
民间曾有过传言，称大昌皇上沉迷修仙，已到不入后宫的地步。
究竟是真的不近女色，还是有什么其他问题，传言里也没说清，也没人敢细问。
如此一来，皇帝对丹药自然极为看重。
为了修为进益，早已将灵丹当做家常便饭。
天天吃月月吃，为了突破瓶颈，对着瓶吃。
丹药虽好，也不能贪杯。
吃多了照样难以下咽，久而久之药膳房便应运而生！
药膳房人不多，算上刚来的吴谦，总共八个人。
这里没有辣白菜，也没有大肠筋，只有一群为主子分忧的太监，和每天定点定量送来的灵丹灵石。
这些丹药贵重无比，是任何修士都眼馋的资源，连带总管之位也成了要任。
大总管吴厚，是年近百岁的老太监，从药膳房创立便做总管，二十年把持厨政，勤勤恳恳没离开过。
除了年初出了趟远门，办了件小事。
宿主就被这老骗子拐入宫了！
记忆中宿主木讷，老实，无父无母。
空有一副好皮囊，却从未用过。
入宫前在村里是出了名的榆木疙瘩，吃百家饭，干百家活，属于底层中的底层，草原上的草根。
而老太监吴厚，则是吴家村的传奇，年少进京闯荡，期间虽未衣锦还乡，但一直捐钱捐物。
把吴家村一个穷乡僻壤，硬生生捐成富甲一方。
有此善举，村里无不以吴厚为傲，家家恨不得立牌位供起来。
村民们还常拿另一个进京闯荡的人，吴厚的邻居吴老二做对比，
“吴厚老祖宗，吃水不忘挖井人！
再看看隔壁吴老二，这么多年分币不捐，忘本！”
“捐钱？狗日的不问村里要钱就烧高香，你还指望它捐钱。”
“苦了咱老祖宗，都在京城混日子，肯定被那狗日的薅羊毛，好人难啊……”
同样进京的两个人，一个成了老祖宗，一个成了兽人结合体。
这位年老心善的老祖宗，上个月突然回村省亲，衣着简朴，吃喝节省，完全看不出是富家翁。
但朴实的村民依旧恭为上宾。
content_en:
The Medicinal Food Room is affiliated to Shangshan Supervisor. Although it has a high-end name, it is actually just a kitchen.
Different from other imperial chefs, the herbal kitchen has a special nature. It does not cook any ordinary meals and is only responsible for preparing elixirs for the emperor.
It is to combine various refined elixirs with elixirs as a guide, use spiritual springs as agents, and then use the spiritual stone and real fire to make delicious food on the table.
Pills play an important role in the world of cultivating immortals. If it ranks second, then only Gua Pi would dare to rank first.
So then again, although the medicinal kitchen is just a kitchen, it is also the most important kitchen in the palace.
Just because the emperor also cultivates immortality.
Not only practice, but also indulge in it.
There were rumors among the people that Emperor Dachang was so obsessed with cultivating immortals that he no longer wanted to enter the harem.
Whether he was really not a womanizer or if there were some other problems, the rumors didn't make it clear, and no one dared to ask in detail.
As a result, the emperor naturally attached great importance to elixirs.
In order to improve his cultivation, he has long regarded elixir as a daily routine.
Eat every day, every month, in order to break through the bottleneck, eat towards the bottle.
Although the elixir is good, don't be greedy.
Even if you eat too much, it is still difficult to swallow, so over time, the medicated diet room came into being!
There were not many people in the medicine room. Counting Wu Qian who had just arrived, there were eight people in total.
There is no spicy cabbage or large intestines here, only a group of eunuchs who share the master's worries, and the elixirs and spiritual stones delivered at fixed times every day.
These elixirs are extremely valuable and are resources that any monk covets, and the position of general manager has also become an important task.
The chief manager, Wu Hou, is an old eunuch who is nearly 100 years old. He has been the manager since the establishment of the herbal kitchen. He has been in charge of the kitchen for twenty years and has never left it.
Except for a long trip at the beginning of the year and a small errand.
The host was abducted into the palace by this old liar!
In the memory, the host is dull, honest, and has no father or mother.
I have a good leather bag, but I have never used it.
Before entering the palace, he was well-known in the village as an elm lump. He ate from hundreds of families and did hundreds of jobs. He belonged to the bottom of the bottom, a grassroots on the grassland.
The old eunuch Wu Hou is a legend in Wujia Village. He went to Beijing to make a fortune when he was young. Although he never returned home in rich clothes, he continued to donate money and materials.
He donated a remote village in Wujia Village to become a wealthy person.
With this kind deed, everyone in the village was proud of Wu Hou, and every family wanted to set up a memorial tablet to commemorate him.
Villagers often compare Wu Laoer, another person who came to Beijing to make a living, Wu Hou's neighbor.
"Ancestor Wu Hou never forgets the man who dug the well when he was drinking water!
Look at Wu Laoer next door. He has not donated cents for so many years. He has forgotten his roots! "
"Donate money? You are so stupid that you burn incense without asking the village for money, and you still expect it to donate money."
"Our ancestors have suffered a lot. They are all living in the capital. They will definitely be picked off by those idiots. It's hard to be a good person..."
Of the two people who also entered Beijing, one became an ancestor and the other became a beast-human hybrid.
This old and kind-hearted ancestor suddenly returned to the village to visit relatives last month. He was dressed simply and ate and drank frugally. It was impossible to tell that he was a rich man.
But the simple villagers are still respectful guests.
title_en: Chapter 3: Caught on the spot Chapter 4: The old eunuch in charge
